fix: close provider generator with async event stream (#1659)

fix: KeyError 'options_json' crash in 'llm logs -t' markdown output (#1656)

annotate_log_rows() handles --truncate by deleting every *_json key
from the row dicts, but the markdown renderer still read
row["options_json"] and row["schema_json"] unconditionally (three
sites), so any truncated markdown listing crashed with KeyError once a
row carried a non-null value. New-store turn rows always do - the row
builder fills options_json with at least "{}" - and legacy responses
recorded "{}" too, so 'llm logs list -t' was broken for both worlds
since the message-store rendering landed. --json escaped because it
just serializes whatever keys remain.

- llm/cli.py: the three renderer sites use row.get(...) so a removed
  key means "section omitted" instead of a crash
- tests/test_llm_logs.py: regression tests for both stores - a legacy
  row with options_json + schema (asserts -t omits the sections and a
  plain listing still renders them) and a logged mock-model turn

Keep monotonic_ulid() monotonic when the clock does not move forward (#1641)

The increment branch only fired when now_ms == last_ms, so a timestamp
reading at or below the previous one produced a fresh, smaller ULID.
Match the reference JavaScript monotonicFactory, which tests seed <=
lastTime and reuses the previous timestamp.
